name: Backward Walking with Support

instructions.description: Stand between stable supports with a clear path behind.
Step one foot backward and place it securely.
Continue with short steps while looking forward.
Stop before reaching the end of the support area.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.

variations.variationDescription: Backward Walking with Support — Wider-Base Balance Version: Increase the base of support to reduce balance demand.

commentsNotes: Use a clear path and continuous stable support.
